bench_aligners_simd_chaining_endpoint_qu.title: SIMD chaining bounded endpoint qualification
bench_aligners_simd_chaining_endpoint_qu.description: Two-row absolute qualification gate. The real row owns all biological work: it runs bounded SIMD, exact SIMD, and bundled minimap2 sequentially on each fixed one-target fixture, requires one normalized primary from each backend, and includes a source-constructed prefix/repeat-bank/repeat-wall/suffix default-max-skip=25 fixture whose own proof must show cutoff, skipped candidates, and a winning older-global-best rescue. Its endpoint participates in the same strict <15-bp maxima. The clearly labelled zero-reference row performs no biological work and exists only because framework rules compare rows rather than literals. Ordinary rules reject failures while preserving complete report and raw evidence; wall time and endpoint maxima remain diagnostics. primary_correct_fraction is emitted as 1.0 by both rows only to satisfy the config-global historical-regression metric contract and is not an endpoint acceptance signal.

bench_prefilter_kernels.title: SneakySnake prefilter kernels (original/scalar/SIMD/Vulkan)

The measured backend_batch region is the complete selected batch API call; for Vulkan it includes upload, dispatch, synchronization, and result readback. callback_total additionally includes output materialization and separately reported runtime validation, while callback_non_backend is its difference from backend_batch. No per-row pseudo end-to-end number incorrectly adds the shared input setup. These <=250 bp fixtures use one complete maze (t=y=len), avoiding the source implementation's multi-maze tail quirks. CPU/source rows sweep E=2/8/40/100; Vulkan rows sweep only the kernel's evaluated E=2/8/16/31 domain. Every available row is validated after backend timing against source decisions and exact ED truth; available Vulkan rows additionally require status-0 execution and exact scalar lower-bound/status/decision parity. Vulkan-unavailable rows are nonblocking and never CPU-fallback.

bench_prefilter_pipeline.title: SneakySnake full-pipeline regional impact
bench_prefilter_pipeline.description: Controlled on/off regional-impact benchmark in the existing aligner harness. Every row uses TWO_STACK_NTHASH + bounded SIMD_MM2 + KSW2, computes exact edit distance, and exposes only matches with ED<=16. The varied dimension is prefilter off versus scalar/SIMD/Vulkan. E=16 lies inside the Vulkan kernel's evaluated E<=31 domain, so the GPU row must report evaluated maze jobs and zero status-2 jobs. Named-region output includes sneaky_snake_prefilter and mm_align_skeleton. Operation-originated proof reports actual backend dispatches, status-classified jobs, rejected jobs/regions, survivors, KSW2 calls, and input-cell area; enabled rows fail closed unless proof is present with non-empty work from the selected backend, while the off row requires proof absence. A shared zero-work evaluator ledger records framework-resolved off/Vulkan schedule provenance by threshold, requires an available Vulkan row to have a scheduled same-threshold off row, compares their actual timed match counts as soon as both repeat-zero rows have completed, rejects count changes across repetitions, and never replays either pipeline. Hardware-Vulkan absence reports required/performed/passed=0 without CPU fallback or a blocking comparison.
